about.section_subtitle: A passionate programmer on a journey to master the digital world
about.desc_1: Hi! I'm Dhruv Prajapati, a third-year BCA student at Smt. B. K. Mehta IT Center, Palanpur. My journey into programming began with curiosity, and it quickly turned into a deep passion for building meaningful applications.
about.desc_2: I'm currently mastering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, C, C#, Java, SQL, and beginning my exploration of Python. My ultimate goal is to become a skilled Full Stack Developer who bridges the worlds of AI and web technology.

education.card_2_desc: Mastered C, C#, Java programming. Started building web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and PHP. Created my first Student Management System and Calculator projects.
